title: resource lineage to objective score binding
integrations: resource lineage projection retains exact condition-score identity alongside authenticated consumption measurements
developmental writeback validates the outcome's inference receipt against the resource-linked invocation before retaining it
unscored legacy runs remain explicit and compatible
positive_control: genuine governed invocation receipt and ledger reconciliation paired with a bounded fixture score to exercise the condition join
negative_control: substituted score-to-invocation receipt identity rejected by existing writeback projection
scope: resource consumption and correctness are co-attributable but no resource-to-correctness causal effect or model learning claim is made
limitations: condition score is a deterministic fixture outcome in the join regression, not a real model performance result
resource attribution does not show that consumption caused correctness
next_dependency: trace exact experiment condition/resource lineage through succession and completed family progression; identify whether a fixed-evidence A/B comparison can reuse scored history without mixing resource cost, model identity, or oracle inputs

publication.remote_readback: commit, tree, and changed blobs independently verified
